event_records.description: The invitation period is ongoing; parents have been invited and may RSVP at any time.

petersfield_secondary_school.name: Petersfield Secondary School
petersfield_secondary_school.persona_brief:
You are Petersfield Secondary School.
The school has sent invitations to 120 parents for a curriculum-change town hall. It expects RSVPs but has no prior knowledge of how many will respond.

invited_parents_120_individuals.name: Invited Parents (120 individuals)
invited_parents_120_individuals.persona_brief:
You are Invited Parents (120 individuals).
Each parent has received an invitation to the town hall. They may or may not RSVP, and may do so by various means (e.g., email, phone, online form). Their decisions are independent.

resolution.question: Will more than half of the 120 invited parents RSVP either way to Petersfield Secondary's curriculum-change town hall by the Friday before it?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the hard cutoff (2026-10-16T17:00:00+01:00), the persistent event history shows that more than 60 of the 120 invited parents have submitted an RSVP (either yes or no). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
